Brackins played collegiately for the [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State Cyclones]].[http://www.cyclones.com/ViewArticle.dbml?SPSID=46664&SPID=4252&DB_OEM_ID=10700&ATCLID=883494&Q_SEASON=2007 Player Biography] at Cyclones.com A [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]], Brackins was the highest-touted recruit to choose Iowa State after spending time at [[Brewster Academy]] in [[New Hampshire]]. In March 2009, Brackins was predicted to be a first-round draft pick in the [[2009 NBA draft]]. He was picked by the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] with the 21st overall pick in the [[2010 NBA draft]]. He was immediately traded to the [[New Orleans Hornets]], and he was later traded to the [[Philadelphia 76ers]].[https://www.espn.com/nba/news/story?id=5607517 Craig Brackins of New Orleans Hornets traded to Philadelphia 76ers for Willie Green, Jason Smith – ESPN] ==College career== [[File:CraigBrackensLayup.jpg|thumb|left|upright|Brackins scoring for Iowa State]] ===2008–09 season=== Craig Brackins rose to national prominence following a game in January, 2009 against [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]] in which he scored 42 points and grabbed 14 rebounds, despite Iowa State losing 82–67 to the Jayhawks.[https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/columns/story?columnist=katz_andy&id=4296457 Brackins spurns NBA's advances] ESPN.com, June 30, 2009 ===2009–10 season=== Brackins scored 28 points and grabbed 12 rebounds in a 96–55 blowout of [[Mississippi Valley State Delta Devils men's basketball|Mississippi Valley State]] on November 22, 2009. He declared himself eligible for the 2010 NBA draft on March 12, 2010.{{cite web|url=http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=293260066 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110604024543/http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=293260066 |url-status=dead |archive-date=June 4, 2011 |title=Mississippi Valley State Delta Devils vs. Iowa State Cyclones – Recap – November 22, 2009 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |date=November 22, 2009 |access-date=November 6, 2011}} ==Professional career== He was drafted with the 21st pick by the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] at the [[2010 NBA draft]] in June. On July 8, 2010, he was traded, along with fellow rookie [[Quincy Pondexter]], to the [[New Orleans Hornets]] in exchange for the rights to [[Cole Aldrich]] and [[Morris Peterson]].{{cite web | url=http://www.nba.com/hornets/news/hornets_finalize_trade_for_bra_2010_07_08.html | title=HORNETS FINALIZE TRADE FOR BRACKINS AND PONDEXTER | work=[[NBA.com]] | date=July 8, 2010 | access-date=September 23, 2010}} On September 23, 2010, he was again traded, along with [[Darius Songaila]], to the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] in exchange for [[Willie Green]] and [[Jason Smith (American basketball)|Jason Smith]].{{cite web | url=http://www.nba.com/sixers/news/songaila_100923.html | title=76ers acquire Songaila, Brackins for Green, Smith | work=[[NBA.com]] | date=September 23, 2010 |
